# kaprera

> kaprera builds custom business systems that replace Excel sheets, WhatsApp orders and paperwork with one system built around how your team already works, and automate the repetitive work. Based in Beirut, Lebanon. First working version (MVP) in 1 week, full custom system in 3 weeks. Websites, landing pages and SEO too. Arabic and English.

- Does NOT build: native mobile apps (iOS/Android). Systems are web-based and work on any phone in the browser.

## Questions and answers

### About kaprera

**What is kaprera?**  
kaprera is a software agency in Beirut, Lebanon. We build custom business systems that replace Excel sheets, WhatsApp orders and paperwork with one system built around how a team already works. We also build MVPs for startups, websites and landing pages, and do SEO.

**Where is kaprera based?**  
In Beirut, Lebanon. We work with clients across Lebanon and remotely with teams in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC.

**Who founded kaprera?**  
kaprera was founded by Ibrahim Hussein, who leads every project from the first call to launch.

**What does kaprera do in one sentence?**  
We turn the spreadsheets, chat groups and paperwork a business runs on into one custom system, built in weeks, not months.

**Is kaprera a marketing agency?**  
No. kaprera is a software agency. We build systems, MVPs and websites. We do SEO for the sites we build, but we do not run ads or social media accounts.

**Does kaprera build mobile apps?**  
No. We build web-based systems and web apps that open in any browser, on a computer or a phone, so your team can use them anywhere without installing anything. We do not build native iOS or Android apps.

**What languages does kaprera work in?**  
Arabic and English. Systems and websites can be fully bilingual, with proper right-to-left (RTL) support for Arabic.

**How can I contact kaprera?**  
WhatsApp or call +961 3 816 405, email info@kaprera.com, or book a call on kaprera.com. On Instagram we are @kaprera_agency.

**What makes kaprera different from other agencies in Lebanon?**  
Three things: we build around how your team already works instead of forcing a ready-made tool on you, we move fast (a first version in 1 week, a full system in 3), and you get a fixed quote before any work starts.

**What do clients say about kaprera?**  
kaprera has five 5-star reviews on its website from clients including Agri Pro Services, Lebanese Spotlight, Oplinx Solutions, AL-Shamaa Engineering and Takkoush Flowers. Zainab Nahouli, CEO of Agri Pro Services, said: "They built a complex, custom system for our pest control services with exceptional speed and efficiency."

### Custom systems

**What is a custom business system?**  
It is software built for one business: its orders, stock, clients, team and reports in one place, shaped around how that business already works. Instead of adapting your work to a generic tool, the system adapts to you.

**Custom system or custom software: what is the difference?**  
Same thing in practice. We say "custom system" because that is how business owners describe it: one system that runs the business. "Custom software" is the technical term.

**Which business problems does a custom system solve?**  
Orders lost in WhatsApp, numbers that never match between Excel files, reports that take hours every week, only one person understanding the spreadsheet, typing the same data twice, and not being able to check the business from your phone.

**What can a kaprera system include?**  
Dashboards with live numbers, order management, stock and inventory, client records (CRM), quotes and invoices, scheduling, field and inspection reports, automatic weekly reports, user roles and an activity log of who changed what.

**Is a custom system the same as an ERP?**  
It can cover what many small businesses need from an ERP (orders, stock, clients, reports) without the cost, complexity and training of a big ERP. You only get the parts your business actually uses.

**Do I need a custom system or is a ready-made tool enough?**  
If a ready-made tool fits how you work, use it. If your team spends every day working around it, copying data between tools or keeping side spreadsheets, a custom system usually pays for itself. We will tell you honestly which one you need.

**How do I know my business needs a system?**  
Count these signs: files named final_v3_REAL, orders living in WhatsApp, only one person who understands the sheet, a weekly report that takes hours, and no way to check numbers from your phone. Three or more means it is time.

**Can a system replace our WhatsApp orders?**  
Yes. Orders that arrive by chat go onto one order board (new, preparing, delivered), so the whole team sees the status and nothing gets buried under unread messages. Customers can be updated automatically.

**Can the system send reports automatically?**  
Yes. Weekly or daily reports build themselves from live data and can be sent to your team at a set time, for example every Monday at 8:00, with no copy-paste and no broken formulas.

**Can each employee see only their part?**  
Yes. Access is set per role: owners see everything, sales see their clients, drivers or technicians see their own jobs. Every change is logged with who, what and when.

**Can I use the system on my phone?**  
Yes. Systems are web-based and work in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer, so you can check sales, orders and stock alerts wherever you are.

**Can field teams file reports from their phones?**  
Yes. Technicians and field teams fill in visit or inspection reports on their phone, and the report lands straight on the admin dashboard, as in the Agri Pro Services platform.

**Can the system stop data entry mistakes?**  
Yes. Unlike a spreadsheet, a system checks each entry, for example against stock levels or price lists, and flags mistakes like typing 120 instead of 12 before they reach a customer.

**Can a system work in Arabic?**  
Yes. Systems can be in Arabic, English or both, with full right-to-left layout for Arabic.

**What kinds of businesses use kaprera systems?**  
Service companies, shops, distributors, NGOs, consultancies and engineering firms: any business that runs on spreadsheets, chat groups and paperwork and has outgrown them.

**Can the system grow with my business?**  
Yes. We start with what you need now and add modules later, such as new reports, new roles or a client portal, without rebuilding from scratch.

**Can you build a client portal?**  
Yes. Clients can log in to see their orders, quotes, reports or bookings, which cuts down the calls and messages asking for updates.

### Replacing Excel

**How do I replace Excel with a system?**  
We start from your current sheets: what each column means, who fills it and who reads it. We turn that into a system with the same information but live, shared, checked and on your phone, then import your existing data so nothing is lost.

**What happens to our existing Excel data?**  
We import it into the new system during setup, so your history, clients and stock are there on day one.

**Why is Excel a problem for a growing business?**  
Excel was not built for a team: copies drift apart, anyone can overwrite anything, there is no history of who changed what, reports are manual, and it does not work well on a phone. It is great for one person and painful for ten.

**Will my team need training?**  
A little. Because the system is built around how your team already works, it feels familiar. We train your team during the go-live week.

**Can we still export to Excel?**  
Yes. Reports and lists can be exported whenever you need them for an accountant or a partner.

**Can you digitise our paper forms?**  
Yes. Paper forms such as job cards, inspection sheets or delivery notes become digital forms that fill in faster, cannot be lost and feed straight into reports.

**How do I stop losing orders that come in on WhatsApp?**  
Put every order on one shared order board instead of in chats. A kaprera order system tracks each order from new to delivered and shows the whole team its status.

**How can I see my sales and stock in real time?**  
With a live dashboard. Sales, orders and low-stock alerts update as your team works, on your computer or phone.

**How can I stop doing the weekly report by hand?**  
Let the system build it. Once your data lives in one place, the weekly report is generated automatically and sent to your team on schedule.

**What if only one person understands our spreadsheet?**  
That is a risk for the whole business. A system writes the rules into the software, so anyone with access can do the work and nothing stops when one person is away.

**Is a system expensive compared to Excel?**  
Excel looks free, but the hours spent copying data, fixing errors and chasing lost orders add up every month. A system usually costs less than those hours within the first year. We give you a fixed quote so you can compare.

**Can we move from Excel to a system without stopping work?**  
Yes. You keep working as usual while we build. We switch over during the go-live week, after your data is imported and your team is trained.

### MVP & startups

**What is an MVP?**  
A minimum viable product: the smallest version of your idea that real people can use. It has your core feature, works on a live link and is used by real users. It is the fastest way to learn whether your idea works before you spend on the full product.

**How fast can kaprera build an MVP?**  
In one week. Day 1 to 2 we scope it, day 3 to 5 we design and build it, and by day 6 to 7 it is live with real users.

**What do I get with a one-week MVP?**  
A working web app on your own link with your core feature, ready for your first users, plus a clear list of what to build next.

**Should my startup build a web app or a mobile app first?**  
Start with a web app: it is the fastest to launch and works on every device. Add a native app later only if your users clearly need it. kaprera builds web apps, not native mobile apps.

**Does my MVP need a landing page?**  
Yes. One page that explains your idea and collects sign-ups lets you learn who wants it before you build everything. We build landing pages alongside MVPs.

**Can the MVP grow into the full product?**  
Yes. We build the MVP so it can grow, adding features based on what your first users actually do.

**Do you work with startups outside Lebanon?**  
Yes. We work remotely with founders in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the GCC over calls, chat and shared files.

**What should I prepare before an MVP call?**  
A short description of the idea, who it is for, the one problem it solves and the main thing a user should be able to do. We help shape the rest.

**Is one week realistic for an MVP?**  
Yes, because an MVP is deliberately small: one core feature done properly. We agree exactly what is in it on day 1 so the week stays focused.

**Can you help me test my startup idea?**  
Yes. An MVP plus a landing page gets your idea in front of real users within a week, so you decide with real feedback instead of guesses.

### Process & pricing

**How long does a custom system take?**  
A first working version with your real data is ready in 1 week, and the full system goes live in 3 weeks. Bigger systems are planned in phases with the same rhythm.

**What are the steps to build a system with kaprera?**  
Four steps: a discovery call about how your team works, a scope with a fixed quote, a first version in week 1 built with your data, then go-live in week 3 with your team trained.

**What happens in week 1?**  
We map how your team works today: the sheets, the groups and the paperwork. By day 7 you have a first working version to try.

**What happens in week 2?**  
We build the system out with your real data, roles and reports, and your team tests it as it grows.

**What happens in week 3?**  
Go-live: data imported, roles set up, team trained and spreadsheets retired.

**How much does a custom system cost?**  
It depends on what the system has to do: how many teams use it, what it tracks and what it connects to. After a short call we send a fixed quote, so you know the full cost before any work starts.

**Do you give a fixed price?**  
Yes. Every project gets a fixed quote after the discovery call, with what we will build and the timeline, before any work starts.

**What if I want to change something during the project?**  
You fill in a short change request form. We reply with the impact on time and cost, and nothing changes until both sides approve it.

**Do you offer support after launch?**  
Yes, as a yearly plan with regular UX, security and performance audits, uptime monitoring, updates, and a written note of what we changed after each audit.

**Can I talk to kaprera before deciding?**  
Yes. Book a free discovery call on kaprera.com or message us on WhatsApp at +961 3 816 405. Tell us how you work today and we will tell you what we would build.

**How do we stay updated during the project?**  
You see progress every week: a working version by day 7 and regular updates on WhatsApp or email until go-live.

**Do you work in Beirut time?**  
Yes. Our working hours are Beirut time, and we run projects remotely for clients in other time zones over calls, chat and shared files.

### Websites & SEO

**Does kaprera build websites?**  
Yes. We build websites and landing pages that turn visits into enquiries: bilingual Arabic and English, fast on a weak connection, with one clear action on every page.

**Website or landing page: which do I need?**  
A landing page is one page with one goal, best for a launch, an event, an ad campaign or an MVP. A website has several pages for your company profile, services and news, and builds your presence on Google over time.

**How can my website bring me more clients?**  
Give every page one clear next step and send each enquiry straight to your WhatsApp or your system, so no lead waits in an inbox.

**How long does a website take?**  
A landing page takes 1 to 2 weeks and a multi-page website 3 to 6 weeks.

**What does every landing page come with?**  
Every landing page ships set up and checked before launch: Google Business Profile, basic SEO (titles, structured data, sitemap; Lighthouse SEO 100), Google Analytics (GA4) with enquiries tracked, Lighthouse Performance 90+, Accessibility (A11Y, WCAG) 90+ and Best practices 100, Core Web Vitals within Google's targets (FCP under 1.8 s, LCP under 2.5 s, TBT under 200 ms, CLS under 0.1, INP under 200 ms), HTML compressed with GZIP/Brotli, preloaded fonts, zero W3C HTML and CSS errors, minimal third-party origins, security headers (HTTPS, CSP, HSTS) and delivery from a global CDN.

**Can website enquiries go to WhatsApp?**  
Yes. Quote and contact forms can send each new enquiry straight to your WhatsApp, or into your system as a new lead.

**Do you build bilingual Arabic and English websites?**  
Yes, with proper right-to-left support for Arabic and a language switch that mirrors the whole layout.

**Is SEO included in every website?**  
The basics are: fast pages, Google Analytics and Search Console set up, structured data, internal links and, for businesses with a location, the Google Business Profile. Ongoing content and keyword work is a separate engagement.

**Can you help my business show up on Google in Lebanon?**  
Yes. Local SEO for Lebanon: Google Business Profile, local pages (for example Beirut, Saida or Jezzine), structured data and pages built around what your customers search for.

**Do you build online stores?**  
Yes, we can set up Shopify online stores.

**What technologies does kaprera use?**  
We pick the stack per project: Next.js, Nuxt, Node.js and Tailwind CSS for systems and web apps, and plain HTML for simple pages that do not need a framework.

### Work & results

**What has kaprera built?**  
Custom systems such as the Agri Pro Services operations system (plus its landing page), the Lebanese Spotlight volunteer system (plus its website), the Takkoush Flowers order and delivery system and the Wafica Design events management system, plus websites for Bayader Investments, Oplinx Solutions and AL-Shamaa Engineering.

**What did kaprera build for Agri Pro Services?**  
A role-based operations platform for a pest control company in Lebanon: a live dashboard, a deal pipeline with quotes, visit scheduling, and field and inspection reports filed from the phone that land straight on the admin dashboard. We also built their bilingual website.

**What did kaprera build for Lebanese Spotlight?**  
A volunteer management platform for a youth-led NGO in Beirut with 300+ volunteers: sign-ups, workshops and records in one place. Results: 60% faster volunteer onboarding, 2× workflow efficiency and 35% more active volunteers.

**What did kaprera build for Takkoush Flowers?**  
An order and operations system for their Hamra branch that replaced a shared spreadsheet: an orders board from pending to delivered, instalment payments, drivers for deliveries, customers, expenses and reports. Their sales manager called it "a game changer for our shop".

**What did kaprera build for Wafica Design?**  
A management system for an events decoration company (weddings, engagements, baby showers, rentals) that replaced their Excel finance file: events with their own expenses and profit, customers, team attendance and payroll, and reports.

**What did kaprera build for Bayader Investments?**  
A corporate website for an investment firm in Saudi Arabia, with a page for each investment line, a news section the team updates itself and one route for investor enquiries. Results: 55% faster load speed, 48% more engagement and 32% more SEO visibility.

**Has kaprera worked with NGOs?**  
Yes, for example the Lebanese Spotlight volunteer platform and the War Action Research interactive research platform.

**Which industries does kaprera serve?**  
ICT and technology, education, NGOs, consulting, management consulting, agriculture and pest control, engineering services and retail, including a flower shop.

**Where can I see kaprera case studies?**  
On kaprera.com/work, with a page per project and the measured results.
